instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have precise data-testid attributes.
Support both light and dark themes using Tailwind class 'dark', with default being the warm earthy light theme.
Implement full multilingual dynamic switching (IT, EN, DE, ES) for all copy throughout the page.
Include a light backend FastAPI endpoint '/api/booking-request' to persist booking requests and calculate prices.
Make the WhatsApp floating button trigger direct conversation with prefilled property inquiry text.
Ensure responsive design from mobile (370px+) up to large desktop screens.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Never use generic default fonts for headings; load Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header without backdrop-blur.
Every interactive element MUST include data-testid attribute.
Add transition for specific properties only (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform), avoid transition: all.
